title: Da Nang vs Hoi An: Which Should You Visit?
description: A data-backed comparison of Da Nang and Hoi An based on Reddit discussions, real costs, beaches, food, and traveler preferences.

categories.title: 🍜 Food & Dining
categories.summary: Hoi An wins on food heritage: Cao Lau, White Rose dumplings, and Banh Mi Phuong are uniquely its own. Da Nang wins on fresh seafood value and mi quang noodles.
redditQuotes: The famous Anthony Bourdain banh mi spot is in Hoi An — r/solotravel

categories.title: ⛩️ Cultural Attractions
categories.summary: Hoi An's UNESCO Ancient Town, Japanese Covered Bridge, and lanterns are unmatched. Da Nang offers Marble Mountains, Ba Na Hills, and the Dragon Bridge fire show.

categories.title: 💰 Cost Comparison
categories.summary: Da Nang is 15–25% cheaper overall. Budget hostel: Da Nang ₫120k–200k ($5–8) vs Hoi An ₫150k–250k ($6–10). Mid-range hotel: Da Nang ₫500k–1.2M vs Hoi An ₫600k–1.5M.

categories.title: 🏖️ Beaches
categories.summary: Da Nang's My Khe is one of Asia's best urban beaches — 30km long, clean, swimmable. Hoi An's An Bang Beach is quieter and more laid-back.

categories.title: 🌤️ Best Time to Visit
categories.summary: February–May is optimal for both. Avoid October–November — Hoi An floods severely. Da Nang handles rain better.

categories.title: 🏨 Where to Stay
categories.summary: Da Nang's My Khe / An Thuong area is the best city base. Hoi An's Ancient Town and An Bang Beach area are top picks for atmosphere and slow travel.

categories.title: 🚌 Getting Around
categories.summary: Da Nang has the airport (DAD). The 30km drive between cities takes 30–40 min. Grab costs ₫200k–300k ($8–12). Hoi An is walkable + bike-friendly.

categories.title: 🎉 Nightlife & Entertainment
categories.summary: Da Nang has Central Vietnam's best nightlife. Hoi An offers magical evening atmosphere with lanterns — earlier closing but more romantic.

categories.title: 🧳 Day Trips
categories.summary: Both are excellent bases: Marble Mountains, Ba Na Hills, My Son Sanctuary, and Hue are all accessible. My Son is closer from Hoi An (40km).

categories.title: 🎯 The Decision Framework
categories.summary: Choose Da Nang for beaches, city life, budget, and nightlife. Choose Hoi An for culture, food heritage, romance, and tailoring.

verdict: Da Nang wins for beaches, city life, and value. Hoi An wins for culture, food heritage, and atmosphere. They're 30km apart — do both. Daily budget: Da Nang ₫600k–1.2M ($24–48) vs Hoi An ₫700k–1.5M ($28–60).

faqs.question: Is Da Nang or Hoi An better for first-time Vietnam visitors?
faqs.answer: Reddit consensus: stay in Da Nang and day-trip to Hoi An. Da Nang offers easier navigation, better beaches, and lower costs. Hoi An's evening lanterns are worth at least one overnight.

faqs.question: How far is Da Nang from Hoi An?
faqs.answer: 30km — 30–40 minutes by Grab (₫200,000–300,000 VND / $8–12 USD). Motorbike rental is ₫100,000–150,000/day ($4–6).

faqs.question: Which has better beaches?
faqs.answer: Da Nang. My Khe Beach is one of Asia's best urban beaches. Hoi An's An Bang is charming but smaller and less maintained.

faqs.question: Which city is cheaper?
faqs.answer: Da Nang, by 15–25%. Budget hostel: ₫120k–200k vs ₫150k–250k. Mid-range hotel: ₫500k–1.2M vs ₫600k–1.5M.

faqs.question: Best time to visit?
faqs.answer: February–May. Avoid October–November — Hoi An floods severely during typhoon season.
